## TL;DR

- **Scale & Intent:** \$4.4T in assets, \$182.4B revenue (2025), \$18B+ annual tech budget targeting 1,000 AI use cases by 2026 (currently 450 deployed). Global CIO Lori Beer directly oversees \$19.8B tech spend with 65,000+ technologists — primary decision-maker for external platforms [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/04/29/capcom-virgin-voyages-bet-on-ai-to-reshape-gaming-and-cruise-travel/) [[32]](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/09/30/jpmorgan-chase-fully-ai-connected-megabank.html)

Investment banking teams need research input 10-20% faster for deal acceleration; 44,000 engineers lack central access to institutional market data without custom ETL [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/04/29/capcom-virgin-voyages-bet-on-ai-to-reshape-gaming-and-cruise-travel/) [[6]](https://www.cio.inc/how-jpmorgan-chase-transforming-into-cloud-first-bank-a-26988) [[13]](https://bullfincher.io/companies/jpmorgan-chase-co/revenue-by-segment)

Apple Card acquisition (Jan 2026, closing ~24 months) signals infrastructure buildout cycle. Q1 2026 earnings showed \$16.5B net income, 10% YoY growth, and 23% ROTCE — capital available for modernization [[11]](https://www.jpmorganchase.com/content/dam/jpmc/jpmorgan-chase-and-co/investor-relations/documents/quarterly-earnings/2026/1st-quarter/a5fd2d13-877b-43b2-8b58-81bad4399c87.pdf) [[16]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/14/jpmorgan-chase-jpm-earnings-1q-2026.html) [[15]](https://public.com/stocks/jpm/earnings)

## Pain Points We Plausibly Solve (Evidence-Backed)

**1. Structured Financial Data at Enterprise Scale**
- **Evidence:** Manages ~1 exabyte; 44,000 engineers need institutional-quality financial data (SEC filings, earnings, regulatory intelligence) without custom ETL [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/04/29/capcom-virgin-voyages-bet-on-ai-to-reshape-gaming-and-cruise-travel/) [[6]](https://www.cio.inc/how-jpmorgan-chase-transforming-into-cloud-first-bank-a-26988) [[32]](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/09/30/jpmorgan-chase-fully-ai-connected-megabank.html)
- **Impact:** Current bottleneck: investment banking deal teams spend 10-20% of cycle time on external research; agentic AI cannot self-serve external data
- **Our angle:** AI-native data integration on AWS; direct access via Python/SQL/REST APIs; pre-parsed SEC filings, earnings transcripts, regulatory alerts

**2. Real-Time Regulatory & Compliance Intelligence**
- **Evidence:** 10-K discloses extensive cybersecurity, vendor risk, data governance, and AI governance concerns; no mention of centralized real-time compliance monitoring tool [[27]](https://fintel.io/doc/sec-jpmorgan-chase-co-19617-10k-2025-february-14-20133-8015) [[29]](https://www.jpmorganchase.com/content/dam/jpmc/jpmorgan-chase-and-co/investor-relations/documents/quarterly-earnings/2025/4th-quarter/corp-10k-2025.pdf)
- **Impact:** Compliance teams manually monitor regulatory changes; vendor cybersecurity alerts siloed; risk team lacks early-warning signals
- **Our angle:** Real-time SEC filing monitoring, regulatory change alerts, vendor security intelligence aggregation

**3. Accelerated Deal Research (Investment Banking)**
- **Evidence:** Investment banking fees up 28% YoY (Q1 2026). Derek Waldron demo showed AI can draft decks in 30 seconds, but upstream research remains manual. [[1]](https://fortune.com/2026/04/29/capcom-virgin-voyages-bet-on-ai-to-reshape-gaming-and-cruise-travel/) [[17]](https://www.investing.com/equities/jp-morgan-chase-earnings)
- **Impact:** M&A cycle time constrained by research phase; 44K engineers lack rapid access to competitive intelligence, target financials, industry benchmarks
- **Our angle:** Rapid target profiling via AI-parsed SEC filings, earnings call transcripts, acquisition history; industry comp matrices auto-built

**4. Vendor & Supply Chain Risk Visibility**
- **Evidence:** 10-K discloses "gaps in oversight of vendors" and "technology asset management" challenges; Todd Combs elevated to Security & Resiliency role specifically (Dec 2025) [[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/jpmorgan-chase-getting-strategic-leadership-110500613.html) [[29]](https://www.jpmorganchase.com/content/dam/jpmc/jpmorgan-chase-and-co/investor-relations/documents/quarterly-earnings/2025/4th-quarter/corp-10k-2025.pdf)
- **Impact:** Vendor cybersecurity risk, quantum encryption transition complexity, third-party exposure monitoring requires real-time intelligence
- **Our angle:** Vendor security profile monitoring, regulatory filing cross-reference (competitor vendor contracts), supply chain mapping via SEC disclosures

**5. AI Risk Governance & Benchmarking**
- **Evidence:** 10-K flags "AI system failures, bias, lack of transparency, insufficient testing" as material risks; Combs' elevated role signals governance focus [[29]](https://www.jpmorganchase.com/content/dam/jpmc/jpmorgan-chase-and-co/investor-relations/documents/quarterly-earnings/2025/4th-quarter/corp-10k-2025.pdf) [[28]](https://www.analystlens.com/stocks/jpm/10k/fy2025)
- **Impact:** 450 AI use cases in production; scaling to 1,000 requires governance framework. No disclosed internal tool for benchmarking against peer AI deployments
- **Our angle:** Competitive AI benchmarking (Peers' disclosed AI initiatives from earnings calls, job postings, SEC risk disclosures); governance best-practice synthesis from public disclosures

**6. Market & Competitive Intelligence (Tier 1)**
- **Evidence:** Markets segment revenue \$35.8B (2025); M&A activity expanding; capital markets research requires real-time competitor positioning [[13]](https://bullfincher.io/companies/jpmorgan-chase-co/revenue-by-segment) [[17]](https://www.investing.com/equities/jp-morgan-chase-earnings)
- **Impact:** Trading desks, wealth managers, corporate development need real-time competitive market data (earnings surprises, corporate actions, sector rotations)
- **Our angle:** Real-time earnings call alerts, supply chain intelligence from SEC filings, competitor financing/M&A tracking

**7. Open Banking Data Governance at Scale**
- **Evidence:** 32M customers, 2B API calls/month; 10-K discloses "privacy challenges" and "consent management complexity" [[28]](https://www.analystlens.com/stocks/jpm/10k/fy2025) [[18]](https://www.jpmorgan.com/payments/newsroom/payments-2026-q1-earnings) [[33]](https://www.jpmorgan.com/insights/payments/embedded-finance-baas/paymentspartnernetwork)
- **Impact:** Payments Partner Network expansion requires real-time consent tracking, regulatory compliance monitoring, customer data lifecycle management
- **Our angle:** Privacy regulation monitoring (state-by-state disclosures), consent framework tracking, data residency requirement updates via regulatory intelligence

## Five Tailored Talking Points

1. **Agentic AI Requires Clean Data Input**
   - Derek Waldron's 30-second investment banking deck demo illustrates the capability, but research quality gates execution speed. Your LLM Suite is only as good as the external data feeding it. We help you integrate institutional-quality financial data (parsed SEC filings, earnings transcripts, regulatory alerts) directly into your data mesh so generative AI has trusted inputs at scale.

2. **One Exabyte of Data, Yet No Centralized Financial Intelligence**
   - You manage ~1 exabyte internally, but structured external financial data (competitor earnings, regulatory filings, market data) remains siloed across departments via disconnected subscriptions (Bloomberg, FactSet, S&P). We consolidate external institutional data on your AWS data lake with your internal Fusion-style architecture, enabling 44K engineers to self-serve market intelligence via APIs without researcher intervention.

3. **M&A Win Rate Improves with Research Velocity**
   - Investment banking fees grew 28% YoY; deal teams are capital-efficient but research-constrained. Cutting research cycle time by 10-20% (via rapid target profiling, auto-built comp matrices, financing history) directly accelerates deal velocity and improves win rates. Agentic AI handles synthesis; your team focuses on strategy.

4. **Compliance & Vendor Risk = Earnings Risk**
   - Your 10-K discloses material vendor oversight gaps and AI governance concerns; Todd Combs' new Security & Resiliency Initiative signals board-level focus. Real-time regulatory monitoring, vendor security profiling, and peer AI governance benchmarking (via competitive filings) move risk management upstream, reducing audit findings and regulatory exposure.

5. **Salesforce Precedent = Platform Consolidation Path**
   - Your Payments Partner Network already runs on Salesforce Commerce Cloud (specialized platform consumption). Financial data should follow the same model: license best-of-breed, integrate via APIs, avoid custom-build burden on Lori Beer's 44K engineers. We fit that archetype for institutional financial research.

## Three Call Questions

1. **Agentic AI Workflow Mapping**
   - "As you scale AI from 450 to 1,000 use cases by end-2026, which multi-step workflows are bottlenecked on external research inputs? Specifically: Are investment banking deal teams, wealth managers, or risk analysts spending time on manual SEC filing review, competitor positioning, or regulatory change monitoring that could be automated if they had programmatic access to that data?"

2. **Data Mesh & External Data Integration**
   - "You've migrated ~1,000 applications to AWS and clearly have a sophisticated data mesh architecture. How are you currently cataloging and provisioning external financial data (SEC filings, earnings transcripts, regulatory intelligence, market data) to 44K engineers? Is it centralized or siloed by division?"

3. **Build vs. Buy on Financial Data Infrastructure**
   - "With Lori Beer's \$19.8B budget and 65K technologists, you could build a proprietary financial data platform.
